acceptance: 閘門是那三支回歸測試：gate 對落後 trunk 的樹必須拒絕並回報 behind_commits、--plan-only 仍能預覽、人類可讀模式也要印得出拒絕訊息。修法落地前這三支不存在（gate 會照跑並把判決綁到一棵永遠不會落地的樹，而且因為 HEAD 沒變、cutover 的新鮮度檢查照樣放行）；現在三支全綠，今天實測 3 passed、rc=0、5.6 秒。日後若有人把 containment 檢查移除或放寬成純警告，這三支會立刻轉紅。
brief: 分支落後主線太久時，合併前的檢查是在舊狀態上做的、等於白驗；不過修法其實已經落地，這張只剩收尾。
detail: worktree_orchestrate.py runs gate BEFORE the rebase that cutover then performs, so for any branch behind main the verdict is bound to a tree that never lands. Measured tonight: feat/dictionary-card-v1 was 58 commits behind (153 ios/ files changed on main since its fork, incl. c5d81fe35 roundness single-DOF over 89 files), feat/review-card-layout-editor 48 behind, feat/reader-liquid-glass 12 behind. The failure is silent and looks like success: cutover requires a fresh non-block verdict whose recorded HEAD == current HEAD, and that check passes because the HEAD did not change — only the base did. Concretely, TodayReviewAutoplayChromeUITests.swift does not exist in the dictionary worktree at all (it entered main via bb02ed3e1 after the fork), so a --grep selecting three UI classes silently matched two; a gate green on that tree says nothing about the three-class tree that actually lands.
plan: 無需再動。241de307f（commit 標題直接點名 IMP-20260806-945e01）已在 cmd_gate 加入方案 (a)：跑任何 gate 之前先 `_base_containment(worktree, trunk)`（:994）判斷 merge-base 是否等於 trunk，落後就以 `_behind_base_refusal`（:1022）印出落後 commit 數與檔案數並回 EXIT_BLOCK，`--plan-only` 仍可預覽路由。回歸測試也在 ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py:1502/1523/1630。關閉本條時把 fixed_by 指向 241de307f。
resolution: 已修（241de307f）：cmd_gate 在跑任何 gate 之前先 _base_containment 判 merge-base 是否等於 trunk，落後就以 _behind_base_refusal 印出落後 commit 數與檔案數並回 EXIT_BLOCK，判決因此綁在會落地的那棵樹上。回歸測試在 test_worktree_orchestrate.py。
scope: 程式不必再動，跑一次那三支既有測試確認，然後把票結掉。
verified_evidence: 結案閘實跑該票自己的 acceptance_cmd，rc 與 acceptance_expect_rc 相符（kind=ran）。這是結案的前置條件：宣稱過期的票會在此被拒絕而非靜靜收掉。
